channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Scam Interceptors
channel.desc: In this celebrity special, Denise van Outen joins the team as they fight back against the scammers targeting the UK. Joining presenters Rav Wilding, Nick Stapleton and reporter Harleen Nottay, Denise tracks down the scammers trading on her name to con people out of money and helps victims pick up the pieces after their brush with the criminals.

channel.title: Bridge of Lies
channel.desc: A team of family and friends, Amy, JP, Nic and Alan, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.
